private.label: Private
private.description: Selected groups can participate. Group managers and owners are auto-assigned moderators.

organization.label: My Organization
organization.description: All members with an account to {orgName} can participate. Org admins and channel owner are auto-assigned moderators. Channel owners can additionally add groups they are a member of by clicking on 'Add participant group' below.
organization.disabledTooltip: Only organization administrators can create organization channels.

public.label: Public
public.description: All signed in members can participate. Org admins and channel owner are auto-assigned moderators. Channel owners can additionally add groups they are a member of by clicking on 'Add participant group' below.
public.disabledTooltip: Only organization administrators can create public channels.

allowAsAnonymous.label: Allow anonymous (signed-in participants only)
allowAsAnonymous.description: The avatar, name, and username of people with accounts who post anonymously will not be available.

confirmation.message: Saving these changes will remove your edit access to this channel. Only organization adminstrators can edit public or organization channels.

participants.label: Participants
participants.helperText: The people who can post, reply, and react to the discussion.

blockWords.label: Blocked words
blockWords.helperText: Comma separated list. Posts and replies that contain them will be hidden automatically.

manage.label: Moderators
manage.helperText: Auto assignment of moderators is based on participant selection. For any additional groups added to the channel, group owners and managers are assigned moderators. Moderators can hide and show posts, add blocked words, and edit channel settings.

validations.minChannelGroups: Private channels require at least one participant group.
validations.allowAsAnonymous: Anonymous posting is only supported by public channels.
validations.blockWords: Enter a maximum of 20 blocked words/phrases (entries separated by comma, no duplicates or blank entries).

notices.edit: Edits will affect everywhere this channel is used

error.title: Channel was not created
error.message: A channel with these access selections already exists. Use the existing channel or modify the selections.

error.title: Channel was not updated
error.message: A channel with these access selections already exists so we can not save these updates.

inaccessibleGroups.title: Unavailable groups: {count}
inaccessibleGroups.message: You cannot view or manage unavailable groups unless you are a member.
